title: Great Buddha, Bamboo Groves & Coastal Walks
description: Escape to ancient Kamakura — home to the Great Buddha, zen temples in bamboo groves, and stunning coastline. April 29 is Showa Day (Golden Week starts), so leave early. Sea breeze and temple serenity are the perfect counterpoint to Tokyo.

activities.title: Train to Kamakura + Hokokuji Bamboo Temple
activities.description: JR Yokosuka Line from Tokyo/Shinjuku to Kamakura (60-75 min, ¥950). Start at Hokokuji — 2,000+ moso bamboo stalks with a hidden matcha tea house. Less crowded than Kyoto's Arashiyama.
details: 📷 Morning light through bamboo is magical

activities.title: Kōtoku-in — The Great Buddha
activities.description: 13.35m bronze Amida Buddha sitting in the open air since 1498 when a tsunami destroyed its hall. Go inside the hollow statue for ¥50 extra. Over 750 years of patina.
details: ⏰ 8:00-17:30 · Enoden to Hase Station (3 min walk)
🏛️ One of Japan's most iconic sights

meals.name: Early Konbini Grab-and-Go
meals.description: Fuel up before the train: onigiri, banana, hot coffee. Aim for the 8:00-8:30 train.

tips.text: ⚡ April 29 is Showa Day — Kamakura PACKED by midday. Catch the 8:00-8:30 train.

activities.title: Hase-dera Temple
activities.description: 5 min from Great Buddha. Hillside temple with Sagami Bay panorama, 9.18m gilt Kannon, and Benten-kutsu cave system lined with candles.

activities.title: Komachi-dōri & Yuigahama Beach
activities.description: Walk back via Komachi-dōri shopping street for snacks, then Yuigahama Beach for a coastal stroll. The Enoden single-track train runs between houses — worth riding.

meals.name: Yasai Tempura — Komachi-dōri
meals.description: Vegetable tempura set: sweet potato, lotus root, shiso, eggplant, shishito peppers. Specify no dashi — use salt instead.

meals.name: Nagi Shokudo — Shibuya
meals.description: Back in Tokyo at this 100% vegan café. Daily set: brown rice, simmered vegetables, miso soup, pickles. Soul food. Cash-only.

tips.text: Nagi Shokudo is soul food of Tokyo vegan dining. Set meal feels like a Japanese grandmother's house.
